title: Setup runs an unrequested live test stream to the target room, even when OBS was idle
test: tests/obsWebSocket.test.js: 'without auto-start the encoder-reset test stream runs at the server's probe, never at the room's WHIP URL (section-49e0545c60d121dd3e784d86/Q-002)', 'with auto-start the only stream sent to the room is the auto-start after the video change; the test stream still goes to the probe (section-49e0545c60d121dd3e784d86/Q-002)', 'a setup that fails after the encoder reset puts back the service OBS had before, not the probe (section-49e0545c60d121dd3e784d86/Q-002)', 'a WHIP URL with no probe address next to it gets no test stream at all, only the restart warning (section-49e0545c60d121dd3e784d86/Q-002)'; tests/whipRoutes.test.js: 'a WHIP probe is answered and connected like a start, but nothing reaches viewers, the relay or the host page (section-49e0545c60d121dd3e784d86/Q-002)', 'a WHIP probe leaves the room's own live session as it is (section-49e0545c60d121dd3e784d86/Q-002)', 'a WHIP probe takes the encoder OBS has, H.264 or AV1, whatever the room streams (section-49e0545c60d121dd3e784d86/Q-002)', 'a WHIP probe is refused, with no transport made, without the host token, for an unknown or non-OBS room, or for an offer it cannot answer', 'a WHIP probe ends when a newer probe of the room replaces it, when its DTLS fails, and at the latest when its lifetime is over', 'the probe address the OBS setup gives OBS is the one this router answers (section-49e0545c60d121dd3e784d86/Q-002)'; guard that passed before and after: 'the public WHIP router has no probe (section-49e0545c60d121dd3e784d86/Q-002)'; changed (pinned the room-targeted order): 'configureObsStream restores the previous service after a later validation failure', 'a rollback already under way when the deadline passes is not cut off', 'an encoder OBS kept from a stream that never connected is released before settings change', 'an idle OBS is assumed to hold an old encoder, because OBS does not say', 'a test stream the room refuses is stopped and reported, not waited on', 'a stop OBS refuses for a test stream that is already down is not a failure (VAL-116)', 'a test stream OBS refuses to start is still stopped and seen idle before the video changes (VAL-116)', 'without auto-start an idle OBS still runs the encoder-reset test stream once, and stops it (section-84098610a3c7f7be0c63f39f/Q-001, VAL-117)'
proof: Holds. configureObsStream wrote the room's WHIP URL and the host token into OBS (SetStreamServiceSettings) and then, for an OBS that was not live, ran the encoder-reset test stream (StartStream, status polls, StopStream) at that URL whether or not autoStart was set, before the video settings changed; the server's POST /whip/broadcast/<room> made producers of it, announced them to the room's viewers (new-producer), told the host page and prewarmed the relay. Owner's answer 3 decided Q-002: keep the reset, send it to a probe target the server accepts but never forwards. On the unchanged code the four new client tests failed on the stream's target (observed StartStream targets ['http://127.0.0.1:3001/whip/broadcast/ABC123'] where ['.../ABC123/probe'] was expected; with auto-start [room, room] for [probe, room]; the URL test got a test stream and no warning), and six of the seven new route tests failed because no probe route existed (404 for the 201, 403 and 409 cases; whipProbeUrl not exported). Fix: whipProbeUrl(whipUrl) adds /probe to the path; for an OBS that was not live the setup writes the probe URL (journaled, so a rollback restores the service OBS had), runs the unchanged reset there, and only after the stream is confirmed stopped writes the room URL (not journaled again, so a rollback puts back the original and not the probe), then the video and encoder settings. lib/whipRoutes.js answers POST /whip/broadcast/:roomCode/probe on the local router only: WHIP enabled, room found, OBS ingest, the host's bearer token, H.264 or AV1 video and a DTLS fingerprint; it creates and connects a WebRtcTransport and answers 201 with createAnswer and a Location under .../probe/<id>, but never calls produce(), emits no viewer event or host metrics, starts no relay and touches no room field or the session registry; one probe per room (a newer one replaces it), closed by DELETE with the host token, by DTLS failed/closed, or 15 s after it began. A real-mediasoup check (scratchpad obs-TASK-096-probe.cjs.txt, real worker, WebRtcServer and transports, DTLS 'connected' delivered through mediasoup's channel as in check 08) gave: probe 201 with an answer, transport connected, zero producers, zero viewer events, host metrics or relay starts, room WHIP fields null, DELETE 200 and transport closed; the same offer to the room's own start made video and audio producers, two new-producer events, host metrics and a relay start. Mutation checks: journaling the room write as well fails six client tests (the restore list gains the probe); registering the probe on the public router fails the public-router test. Verify commands: node --test tests/obsWebSocket.test.js tests/obsWebSocketWire.test.js 74/74; node --test tests/whipRoutes.test.js tests/whip.test.js 92/92; npm run lint and npm run typecheck clean; npm test 1312/1312, and again after merging dev 437b8f2 into the lane (2dee99b): verify commands 74/74 and 105/105, lint and typecheck clean, npm test 1391/1391. Browser: tests/browser/host-obs-control-channel.spec.mjs 3/3 in Chromium through run-e2e.cjs on the lane's own ports. Commit 7fdc09f on lane/obs.

title: Configuration broadcasts even when autoStart is false
test: tests/obsWebSocket.test.js: 'without auto-start the encoder-reset test stream runs at the server's probe, never at the room's WHIP URL (section-49e0545c60d121dd3e784d86/Q-002)'; tests/whipRoutes.test.js: 'a WHIP probe is answered and connected like a start, but nothing reaches viewers, the relay or the host page (section-49e0545c60d121dd3e784d86/Q-002)'
proof: TASK-082 recorded this issue as blocked and left it to TASK-096 (owner's answer 3: keep the reset with autoStart false, on condition that its test stream reaches no viewer). With this change the test stream with autoStart false goes to the server's probe, which produces nothing from it, and OBS is pointed at the room only after the stream is confirmed stopped; no StartStream is sent while the stream service points at the room's WHIP URL. The client test failed on the unchanged code (StartStream target was the room's WHIP URL). See C-acd4cd6d33eb for the fix and checks.
